header: Full-width rows, with room for a real paragraph
lead: Each entry gets an icon on the left and a proper paragraph on the right, with a rule between rows. Use it where a grid cell would cut the argument off after half a sentence.

items.title: One paragraph per entry, not one caption
items.text: The row is as wide as the band, so an entry can carry a claim, the reason behind it and the consequence without being trimmed to fit a column. That is the whole difference between this band and the feature grid it otherwise resembles.

items.title: A rule instead of a gap
items.text: Rows are separated by a hairline rather than by whitespace, which is what stops a long list from reading as several unrelated groups. The rule comes from the list component, so it matches every other divided list on the page.

items.title: Compact when the list gets long
items.text: The compact toggle tightens the vertical padding without touching the type scale, so a ten-entry list stays one band tall instead of pushing everything after it below a second fold.
